queries_run: LITE Lumentum Holdings antitrust OR monopoly investigation 2026
Lumentum Holdings regulation OR regulatory scrutiny Communication Equipment 2026
LITE Lumentum Holdings DOJ OR FTC OR EU competition 2026

findings.claim: 公司 2024-08 收到 BIS 行政傳票與 DOJ 相關傳票，要求提供對華為業務的紀錄；公司持續配合，屬出口管制調查而非反壟斷；未履行出口管制可能面臨罰款、出口權限被拒與政府合約除名。
findings.excerpt: In August 2024, we received an administrative subpoena from BIS requesting the production of records in connection with our business with Huawei. We also received a related subpoena from the U.S. Department of Justice (“DOJ”) that also requested information regarding our business with Huawei. We have been, and will continue to, cooperate with BIS and DOJ in responding to the subpoenas and their ongoing reviews.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素揭露美國關稅、出口管制與制裁法規可能限制對中國等地區銷售並增加成本；232 條款半導體調查可能帶來新關稅。
findings.excerpt: U.S. regulatory activity, such as tariffs, export controls, and economic sanctions laws have in the past, and may in the future, materially limit our ability to make sales to customers in certain regions of the world, including China, and which have in the past, and may in the future, increase our costs and harm our results of operations and financial condition.

findings.claim: 三次搜尋未發現 2026 年 DOJ/FTC/EU 對 Lumentum 的反壟斷調查或拆分風險；10-K 僅一般性提及反壟斷法可能限制併購。
findings.excerpt: In addition, applicable antitrust laws and other regulations may limit our ability to acquire targets or force us to divest all or a portion of our business or an acquired business.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 無反壟斷調查；法規風險主要是出口管制（BIS/DOJ 華為傳票）與關稅。搜尋摘要另提及 2026-08 美國擬禁中國光收發模組（TIKR），未讀原文，未列入。
